description: This file provides utility functions for handling generated output files in a build process, including reading existing files, writing updated content, and reporting status via CLI.

methods.name: writeGeneratedOutput
methods.description: Writes the specified output only if the content has changed, based on the provided parameters.

methods.name: reportGeneratedOutputCli
methods.description: Reports the status of generated output via CLI, including handling of check mode and exit codes.
